sbh2.1:2.4: tadyathā savikalpaṁ pratibimbaṁ, nirvikalpaṁ pratibimbaṁ, vastuparyantatā |
sbh2.1:3.2: yathāpīhaikatyaḥ saddharmaśravaṇaṁ vā avavādānuśāsanīṁ vā niśritya, dṛṣṭaṁ vā, śrutaṁ vā, parikalpitaṁ vopādāya jñeyavastusabhāgaṁ savikalpaṁ pratibimbaṁ samāhitabhūmikairvipaśyanākārairvipaśyati |
sbh2.1:4.2: tadyathā aśubhā vā, maitrī vā, idaṁpratyayatāpratītyasamutpādo vā, dhātuprabhedo vā, ānāpānasmṛtirvā |
sbh2.1:4.5: uparibhūmīnāṁ sātatyaṁ, samudayasatyaṁ, nirodhasatyaṁ, mārgasatyamidamucyate jñeyaṁ vastu |
sbh2.1:5.1: tasyāsya jñeyavastunaḥ avavādānuśāsanīṁ vā āgamya, saddharmaśravaṇaṁ vā, tanniśrayeṇa samāhitabhūmikaṁ manaskāraṁ saṁmukhīkṛtya, tāneva dharmān adhimucyate |
sbh2.1:5.3: sa tasmin samaye pratyakṣānubhāvika iti vādhimokṣaḥ pravartate |
sbh2.1:5.6: samavahitaṁ, saṁmukhībhūtaṁ, na punaranyat tajjātīyaṁ dravyamapi tvadhimokṣānubhavaḥ |
sbh2.1:5.7: sa tādṛśo manaskārānubhavaḥ samāhitabhūmiko, yena tasya jñeyasya vastunaḥ anusadṛśaṁ tad bhavati |
sbh2.1:5.10: yadayaṁ yogaṁ santīrayaṁstasmin prakṛte, jñeye vastuni parīkṣya guṇadoṣāvadhāraṇaṁ karoti |
sbh2.1:6.2: ihāyaṁ yogī pratibimbānnimittamudgṛhya na punaḥ vicinoti |
sbh2.1:6.6: api tu tadevālambanamasaktaṁ ca arthākāreṇa tannimittaṁ śamayati |
sbh2.1:6.7: api tu navākārayā cittasthityā adhyātmameva cittaṁ sthāpayati |
sbh2.1:6.12: tasya tasmin samaye nirvikalpaṁ tatpratibimbaṁ ālambanaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.1:6.14: tadālambanaṁ, no tu vicinoti | parivitarkayati | parimīmāṁsāmāpadyate |
sbh2.1:6.16: itīmāni tasya jñeyavastusabhāgasya pratibimbasya paryāyanāmāni veditavyāni |
sbh2.1:7.4: yasmāt pareṇa rūpaskandho vā, vedanāskandho vā, saṁjñāskandho vā, saṁskāraskandho vā, vijñānaskandho veti |
sbh2.1:7.12: iti yā cālambanasya yāvadbhāvikatā, yā ca yathāvadbhāvikatā tadekatyamabhisaṁkṣipya vastuparyantatetyucyate |
sbh2.1:8.2: yadasya yogina āsevanānvayād bhāvanānvayād bahulīkārānvayāccchamathavipaśyanāyāḥ pratibimbālambano manaskāraḥ |
sbh2.1:8.7: āśrayaparivṛtteśca pratibimbamatikramya tasminneva jñeye vastuni nirvikalpaṁ pratyakṣaṁ jñānadarśanamutpadyate |
sbh2.1:9.5: api caitadālambanaṁ śamathapakṣyaṁ, vipaśyanāpakṣyaṁ, sarvavastukaṁ, bhūtavastukaṁ, hetuphalavastukaṁ ca |
sbh2.1:11.4: kiyatā, bhadanta, bhikṣuryogī yogācāra ālambane cittamupanibaddhaḥ, katamasminnālambane cittamupanibadhnātīti |
sbh2.1:11.6: sādhu, sādhu, revata, sādhu khalu tvaṁ revata |
sbh2.1:11.8: tena hi śrṛṇu ca, sādhu ca, manasi kuru, bhāṣiṣye |
sbh2.1:11.9: iha, revata bhikṣuryogī yogācāraḥ caritaṁ vā viśodhayitukāmaḥ, kauśalyaṁ vā kartukāmaḥ |
sbh2.1:12.2: sa ced revata, bhikṣuryogī yogācāraḥ rāgacarita eva, sa na śubhālambane cittamupanibadhnāti |
sbh2.1:12.4: dveṣacarito vā punarmaitryāṁ, mohacarito vā idaṁpratyayatāpratītyasamutpāde, mānacarito dhātuprabhede |
sbh2.1:12.5: sa ced revata, sa bhikṣuryogī yogācāro vitarkacarita eva ānāpānasmṛtau cittamupanibadhnāti |
sbh2.1:13.1: sa cetsa, revata, bhikṣuḥ saṁskārāṇāṁ svalakṣaṇe saṁmūḍhaḥ, kintu kauśalye cittamupanibadhnāti |
sbh2.1:13.2: hetusaṁmūḍho dhātukauśalye, pratyayasaṁmūḍha āyatanakauśalye, kāmadhātorvā vairāgyaṁ kartukāmaḥ, kāmānāmaudārikatve, rūpāṇāṁ śāntatve, rūpebhyo vā vairāgyaṁ kartukāmaḥ |
sbh2.1:13.4: sarvatra vā satkāyānnirvekṣukāmo, vimoktukāmaḥ, duḥkhasatyeṣu samudayasatye, nirodhasatye, mārgasatye cittamupanibadhnāti |
sbh2.1:14.1: iha revata, bhikṣuryadyadeva jñeyaṁ vastu nicettukāmo bhavati, pracettukāmaḥ |
sbh2.1:14.4: tacca tena pūrvameva dṛṣṭaṁ vā bhavati |
sbh2.1:14.5: śrutaṁ vā | mataṁ vā | vijñātaṁ vā |
sbh2.1:14.6: sa tadeva dṛṣṭamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā, śrutaṁ, mataṁ, vijñātamadhipatiṁ kṛtvā, samāhitabhūmikena manaskāreṇa manasi karoti |
sbh2.1:14.8: sa na tadeva jñeyaṁ vastu samāhitaṁ saṁmukhībhūtaṁ paśyatyapi tu tatpratirūpakamasyotpadyate |
sbh2.1:14.9: tatpratibhāsaṁ vā, jñānamātraṁ vā, darśanamātraṁ vā, pratismṛtamātraṁ vā yadālambanamayaṁ bhikṣuryogī yogācāraḥ samyagevālambane cittamupanibadhnāti |
sbh2.1:15.1: sa cedayaṁ, revata, bhikṣuryogī yogācāra ālambane cittamupanibadhnāti yāvajjñeyaṁ jñātavyaṁ bhavati |
sbh2.1:15.2: tacca yathābhūtamaviparītacittaṁ tamevaṁ hi, revata, bhikṣuryogī yogācāraḥ |
sbh2.1:15.4: kathaṁ ca, revata, bhikṣuryogī yogācāraḥ anirākṛtadhyāyī bhavati |
sbh2.1:15.5: sa cetsa, revata, bhikṣurevamālambane samyakprayujyamānaḥ sātatyaprayogī ca bhavati |
sbh2.1:17.1: tatra yattāvadāha | nimitteṣu caran yogī anena tāvaccchamathanimitte, pragrahanimitte, upekṣānimitte satatakāritā cākhyātā |
sbh2.1:17.2: yatpunarāha | sarvabhūtārthavedaka iti | anena vastuparyantatā ākhyātā |
sbh2.1:17.3: yatpunarāha | bimbadhyāyī sātatikaḥ ityanena savikalpaṁ nirvikalpaṁ ca pratibimbamākhyātam |
sbh2.1:18.2: cittanimittasya kovidaḥ pravivekasya prāvivekyasya ca vidante rasaṁ |
sbh2.1:18.3: dhyāyī nipakaḥ pratismṛto bhuṅkte prītisukhaṁ nirāmiṣaṁ ||
sbh2.1:19.1: tatra yattāvadāha, cittanimittasya kovida ityanena savikalpaṁ nirvikalpaṁ ca pratibimbaṁ nimittaśabdenākhyātaṁ |
sbh2.1:19.3: yatpunarāha | prāvivekyasya ca vidante rasamityanena ālambane samyakprayuktasya prahāṇārāmatā bhāvanārāmatā cākhyātā |
sbh2.1:19.4: yatpunarāha | dhyāyī nipakaḥ pratismṛta ityanena śamathavipaśyanāyā bhāvanāsātatyamākhyātam |
